title: Line endings: devbin's .gitattributes, the vendored copy's LF rule, and doctor naming CR bytes
objective: Hold LF line endings in the repository rather than in each clone's git settings (D46). devbin's own tree gets a root `.gitattributes` carrying `* text=auto eol=lf`, which covers the 40 extensionless scripts a `*.sh` rule would miss and changes no content today. Every project devbin vendors into gets an LF rule covering `bin/devbin` and everything under `bin/.devbin/`, in the shape the design review settles, and `doctor` checks it with `git check-attr eol`. A vendored file that already carries CR bytes is named by `doctor`, with the cause. Criteria AC-1.1 to AC-1.3.
